lines.en: Can you go to the store for me?
lines.ko: 나 대신 가게에 다녀올 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure, Grandma. How do I get there?
Go out the gate and walk down the street.
Then do I go across the road?
Yes. Go past the bank and turn left.
I went there with Dad last week. I remember!
Good. Go into the store and buy milk.
I will come back up the hill fast.
Don't run. Walk around the cars carefully.
lines.ko: 뛰지 마요. 차들 주위로 조심히 걸어요.

lines.en: Okay. I will be back in ten minutes.
Excuse me. How do we get to the paintings?
Go through this door and go up.
Do we go past the shop?
Yes, walk past the shop and turn right.
We walked around the garden this morning. It was beautiful.
Nice. The garden is across from the cafe.
Can we go into the flower room?
Yes, but please turn off your phone inside.
lines.ko: 네, 그런데 안에서는 전화기를 꺼 주세요.

lines.en: Of course. We will go down after lunch.
Great. Then go out through the big door. Enjoy!
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그다음 큰 문으로 나가세요. 즐겁게 보세요!
